name: Almaty (Kazakhstan)

colors.symbolism: the stripes along the top and bottom edges
the central emblem — the sky over the Trans-Ili Alatau
the ornamental ring of the emblem

description: A white field with a red stripe along the top and bottom edges, charged centrally with the round emblem of Almaty — a snow leopard beneath the Tian Shan peaks on light blue, within a golden ornamental ring.
history: Almaty is the largest city in Kazakhstan and was the country's capital until 1997, when the seat of government was moved to Astana. The city has the status of a city of republican significance, administered separately from Almaty Region. The flag and coat of arms reflect both the surrounding Trans-Ili Alatau mountains and the apple from which the city's name derives (Kazakh almaty / alma = apple).

features.role: stripes along the top and bottom edges

features.symbolism: the Trans-Ili Alatau mountains, a snow leopard and the city's apple heritage
